title: MedPAO-Assist：可边缘部署、模态感知的放射报告结构化智能体AI
summary: 提出MedPAO-Assist，一个可边缘部署的多智能体框架，基于0.6B参数小模型，在笔记本CPU上仅需约3.3GB内存、约31秒延迟，即可从放射科医生口述和语音指令生成结构化报告，支持四种影像模态，采用提取-对齐-生成范式，无需联网或外部API。
summary_en: MedPAO-Assist is an edge-deployable multi-agent framework built on a 0.6B-parameter small language model that generates structured radiology reports from dictation and voice commands, using ~3.3 GB peak RAM and ~31s latency on a laptop CPU across four imaging modalities, following an Extract-Ground-Generate paradigm with no internet or external API calls.
